features.title: Infrastructure You Control
features.subtitle: Self-hosted, auditable, deterministic.
features.card1Desc: GhostBill never holds private keys or funds. Payments go directly from customer to merchant wallet. No intermediaries. No custody risk.
features.card2Desc: Runs as a Tor hidden service by default. All outgoing connections routed through Tor. Privacy is the baseline, not an option.
features.card3Desc: 13 webhook events covering the full invoice and subscription lifecycle. HMAC-SHA256 signed. 7 automatic retries. Build reactive systems without polling.
features.card4Desc: 7 invoice states with explicit transitions. Partial payments, overpayments, late payments — all handled automatically. No hidden failures.
features.card5Desc: Customer management, automated renewal with configurable grace periods, 5-status subscription lifecycle. Deterministic billing anchors prevent drift.
features.card6Desc: Docker Compose deployment. 5 containers, 15 minutes setup. Runs on VPS, bare metal, or local node. No SaaS dependency. Ever.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Four steps from deployment to payment.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Run the Docker image. Configure wallet RPC. Expose as Tor hidden service.
howItWorks.step2Desc: One API call generates a unique subaddress. Set amount, description, expiry.
howItWorks.step3Desc: GhostBill monitors mempool and blockchain. Detects payments in seconds.
howItWorks.step4Desc: HMAC-signed event fires to your server. Verify, fulfill, done.

access.title: Access Methods
access.subtitle: Choose your connection layer. Privacy is the default.
access.clearnet1: Standard HTTPS routing for high-speed API calls
access.clearnet2: Cloudflare DDoS protection for public endpoints
access.tor1: End-to-end onion routing. No IP metadata leak.
access.tor2: Native V3 hidden service for API + Dashboard.
access.tor3: All outgoing webhooks routed through Tor.
access.disclosure: GhostBill does not collect IP addresses, cookies, or browser fingerprints on either access method. Tor provides maximum privacy — no third party sees your traffic. Clearnet routes through Cloudflare, which sees connection metadata. Your Monero transactions remain private regardless.

deploy.step2Desc: Set RPC endpoint and wallet connection in .env file.
deploy.step3Desc: Expose as Tor hidden service (recommended) or clearnet.
deploy.step4Desc: One API call. Start accepting Monero immediately.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Technical questions answered.
faq.q1: Does GhostBill ever hold private keys?
faq.a1: No. GhostBill uses your secret view key to detect payments. Private spend keys never touch the server. Even full root compromise cannot move funds.
faq.a2: Invoices are monitored through wallet-RPC connected to your Monero node. Payment state transitions occur after required block confirmations. No off-chain heuristics.
faq.q3: What happens if the server restarts?
faq.a3: Invoice state is persisted in PostgreSQL. On restart, GhostBill re-syncs pending invoices against the node. No payments are lost.
faq.a4: Tor is recommended and enabled by default. Clearnet access can be configured but internally all outgoing connections (webhooks, price feeds) route through Tor.
faq.a5: No. Zero protocol fees, zero platform fees. You control the infrastructure. Payments go directly from customer to your wallet.
faq.a6: Yes. GhostBill is licensed under AGPL-3.0. Full source code is available. You can review, modify, and deploy your own version.
